The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Flags that the provider's cancel response is never checked before deleting the local record
- Flags deleting the row at all, rather than setting a cancelled status and keeping it
- Explains the risk: if the provider call fails, the local system shows the subscription gone while the provider may still be billing it, with no record left to catch the mismatch

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
